newsitem.title: USA: Bids for surplus US lead range $0.2799-$0.2995/lb.
newsitem.headline: Bids for surplus US lead range $0.2799-$0.2995/lb.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said Friday that it received bids from 10 companies to buy surplus lead at prices ranging from $0.2799 to $0.2995 per pound.
The high bidder was Amerway, which bid for 500 tonnes of lead in five lots of 100 tonnes at $0.2995 per pound.
The low bidder was Ney Smelting & Refining, which offered to buy 180 tonnes of lead in three lots of 60 tonnes at $0.2799 per pound, the agency said.
